description:
We discuss a serious fire at the ion accelerator at GSI, and its various implications for the science community. More links and info in full description ↓↓↓

See our full playlist of videos from GSI: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL9eEsN9D48mcE6ElMkQcG28EE2EPbJWXI

The GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research: https://www.gsi.de/en/start/news
FAIR: https://www.gsi.de/en/researchaccelerators/fair
Video report on the fire (in German): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=54_D6R0udwY

Video features Sir Martyn Poliakoff from the University of Nottingham and Carola Pomplun from GSI.

Videos on all 118 elements: http://bit.ly/118elements

Support us on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/periodicvideos

More chemistry at http://www.periodicvideos.com/
From the School of Chemistry at The University of Nottingham: http://bit.ly/NottChem
